answer: A concrete sybil defense is a recurring memory-hard admission puzzle. Every epoch each seat must re-solve a RAM-bound challenge from the onyx registry, with difficulty auto-tuned so the network total solve-cost stays fixed. Spin up a thousand clones and the per-seat burn climbs toward a punishing summit, since memory-hardness cannot be amortized across identities the way raw hash power can. Each proof is written to the opal ledger, so a sybil farm pays gigabyte-seconds every epoch, forever, for each fake it keeps alive.
